Application Data.NAME: Acme Self Storage, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Acme Self Storage, LLC operates a secure self-storage facility offering a variety of unit sizes for both personal and business use. Our services include 24/7 access to storage units, climate-controlled options, and additional amenities such as packing supplies and on-site moving assistance. We prioritize the safety and security of our customers' belongings with state-of-the-art surveillance systems and gated access.
Application Data.GENERAL INFO QUESTIONS:

2. No - The business does not sponsor athletic teams or engage in any sports-related activities.

12. No - The applicant has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a water leak was detected in one of the ground floor storage units due to a malfunctioning pipe, resulting in damages to several stored items. The amount of the claim was $2,500.00, and the status is closed.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class I, Grade A, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: CCTV surveillance with motion sensors, perimeter fencing, and on-site security personnel during business hours
